diseases.name: Acne
diseases.description: A common skin condition where hair follicles get clogged with oil and dead skin, causing pimples, blackheads and whiteheads.
advice: Wash your face twice a day with a gentle cleanser
Avoid squeezing or picking pimples
Use non-comedogenic (oil-free) skin products
diseases.see_doctor: See a dermatologist if acne is severe, painful, leaves scars or does not improve after a few weeks.

diseases.name: Allergy
diseases.description: An overreaction of the immune system to substances such as pollen, dust, food or animal hair, causing sneezing, itching, rash or watery eyes.
advice: Try to identify and avoid the trigger
Keep your home clean and dust-free
Over-the-counter antihistamines may help (ask a pharmacist)
diseases.see_doctor: Seek emergency care immediately if you have swelling of the face or throat or difficulty breathing.
red_flags: Swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat

diseases.name: Arthritis
diseases.description: Inflammation of one or more joints, causing pain, stiffness and swelling that often worsens with age.
advice: Stay active with gentle, low-impact exercise
Maintain a healthy body weight
Warm or cold compresses can ease pain
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor if joint pain lasts more than a few weeks or a joint becomes red, hot and swollen.
red_flags: A joint that is suddenly hot, red and very swollen

diseases.name: Bronchial Asthma
diseases.description: A chronic condition in which the airways narrow and swell, causing wheezing, coughing, chest tightness and shortness of breath.
advice: Avoid triggers such as smoke, dust and cold air
Always carry your prescribed inhaler
Do not smoke
diseases.see_doctor: Seek emergency care if breathing becomes very difficult or your inhaler does not help.
red_flags: Severe shortness of breath or difficulty speaking

diseases.name: Cervical Spondylosis
diseases.description: Age-related wear of the discs and joints in the neck, causing neck pain, stiffness and sometimes headaches or arm numbness.
advice: Keep a good posture, especially at the computer
Do gentle neck stretching exercises
Use a supportive pillow
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor if you have numbness or weakness in your arms or hands, or loss of balance.
red_flags: Numbness or weakness in the arms or legs
Loss of bladder or bowel control
Trouble walking or loss of balance

diseases.name: Chicken Pox
diseases.description: A highly contagious viral infection causing an itchy rash of small fluid-filled blisters, fever and tiredness.
advice: Stay at home until all blisters have crusted over
Avoid scratching; trim your nails
Calamine lotion and cool baths can relieve itching
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor if the rash spreads to the eyes, the skin becomes very red and painful, or you are pregnant or have a weak immune system.
red_flags: High fever lasting more than 4 days

diseases.name: Common Cold
diseases.description: A mild viral infection of the nose and throat causing a runny nose, sneezing, sore throat and cough.
advice: Rest and drink plenty of fluids
Gargle with warm salt water for a sore throat
Wash your hands often to avoid spreading it
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor if symptoms last more than 10 days or you have a high fever or trouble breathing.

diseases.name: Dengue
diseases.description: A mosquito-borne viral infection causing high fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, joint and muscle pain and rash.
advice: Rest and drink plenty of fluids
Use paracetamol for fever; avoid aspirin and ibuprofen
Prevent mosquito bites
diseases.see_doctor: Seek medical care promptly, and urgently if you have bleeding, severe abdominal pain or persistent vomiting.
red_flags: Bleeding from the gums or nose

diseases.name: Diabetes
diseases.description: A long-term condition where blood sugar is too high, often causing excessive thirst, frequent urination, tiredness and weight loss.
advice: Limit sugar and refined carbohydrates
Exercise regularly
Have your blood sugar checked
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor for a blood sugar test if you have these symptoms; diabetes needs medical management.
red_flags: Fruity-smelling breath with nausea or vomiting

diseases.name: Dimorphic Hemorrhoids
diseases.description: Swollen veins in the lower rectum and anus, causing pain, itching, discomfort and sometimes bleeding during bowel movements.
advice: Eat high-fiber foods and drink plenty of water
Avoid straining during bowel movements
Warm sitz baths can relieve discomfort
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor if you have rectal bleeding, as it can also be a sign of other conditions.

diseases.name: Drug Reaction
diseases.description: An unwanted reaction of the body to a medicine, which can cause rash, itching, fever or swelling.
advice: Stop taking the suspected medicine only after asking your doctor
Keep a list of medicines you react to
Tell every doctor about your drug allergies
diseases.see_doctor: Seek emergency care immediately if you have swelling of the face, lips or throat, or difficulty breathing.
red_flags: Swelling of the face, lips or throat

diseases.name: Fungal Infection
diseases.description: An infection of the skin, nails or other areas caused by fungi, often causing itching, redness and scaly patches.
advice: Keep the affected area clean and dry
Do not share towels or shoes
Antifungal creams are available (ask a pharmacist)
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor if the infection spreads, does not improve in two weeks, or you have diabetes or a weak immune system.

diseases.name: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease
diseases.description: A condition where stomach acid flows back into the esophagus, causing heartburn, a sour taste and chest discomfort after eating.
advice: Eat smaller meals and avoid lying down right after eating
Limit spicy, fatty foods, coffee and alcohol
Raise the head of your bed
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor if you have difficulty swallowing, weight loss or symptoms more than twice a week. Chest pain should always be checked.
red_flags: Chest pain, especially with shortness of breath or arm/jaw pain

diseases.name: Hypertension
diseases.description: High blood pressure; often has no symptoms but can cause headaches, dizziness and increases the risk of heart disease and stroke.
advice: Reduce salt intake
Exercise regularly and keep a healthy weight
Measure your blood pressure regularly
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor to have your blood pressure checked; seek emergency care for severe headache, chest pain or vision problems.
red_flags: Severe headache with confusion or vision problems
Chest pain or shortness of breath
Weakness or numbness on one side of the body

diseases.name: Impetigo
diseases.description: A contagious bacterial skin infection, common in children, causing red sores that burst and form honey-colored crusts.
advice: Keep the sores clean and covered
Avoid touching or scratching them
Do not share towels
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor; impetigo usually needs antibiotic cream or tablets.

diseases.name: Jaundice
diseases.description: Yellowing of the skin and eyes caused by high bilirubin levels, often a sign of a liver or gallbladder problem.
advice: Avoid alcohol
Drink plenty of fluids
Do not take medicines without medical advice
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor promptly; jaundice always needs medical investigation.

diseases.name: Malaria
diseases.description: A serious mosquito-borne parasitic infection causing high fever, chills, sweating, headache and body aches.
advice: Seek medical testing as soon as possible
Prevent mosquito bites with nets and repellents
Drink plenty of fluids
diseases.see_doctor: Seek medical care urgently, especially if you have recently been in a malaria region; malaria can become life-threatening.
red_flags: Fever after travel to a malaria region

diseases.name: Migraine
diseases.description: A type of headache causing intense throbbing pain, often on one side, with nausea and sensitivity to light and sound.
advice: Rest in a quiet, dark room
Keep regular sleep and meal times
Note your triggers in a headache diary
diseases.see_doctor: Seek emergency care for a sudden, very severe headache or a headache with weakness, confusion or vision loss.
red_flags: Headache with fever and stiff neck

diseases.name: Peptic Ulcer Disease
diseases.description: Open sores in the lining of the stomach or small intestine, causing burning stomach pain, bloating and nausea.
advice: Avoid painkillers like aspirin and ibuprofen unless prescribed
Limit alcohol and stop smoking
Eat regular, smaller meals
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor; seek emergency care if you vomit blood or have black, tarry stools.
red_flags: Vomiting blood or material that looks like coffee grounds

diseases.name: Pneumonia
diseases.description: An infection that inflames the air sacs of the lungs, causing cough with phlegm, fever, chills and difficulty breathing.
advice: Rest and drink plenty of fluids
Do not smoke
Complete any prescribed treatment
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor promptly; seek emergency care if you have trouble breathing, chest pain or bluish lips.

diseases.name: Psoriasis
diseases.description: A chronic skin condition causing red, itchy, scaly patches, most often on the elbows, knees and scalp.
advice: Moisturize your skin daily
Avoid scratching and skin injuries
Manage stress, which can trigger flare-ups
diseases.see_doctor: See a dermatologist for diagnosis and treatment options, or if you also have joint pain.

diseases.name: Typhoid
diseases.description: A bacterial infection spread through contaminated food and water, causing prolonged high fever, weakness, stomach pain and headache.
advice: Drink only safe, boiled or bottled water
Wash your hands before eating
Rest and stay hydrated
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor promptly; typhoid needs antibiotic treatment.

diseases.name: Urinary Tract Infection
diseases.description: An infection in the urinary system causing a burning feeling when urinating, frequent urge to urinate and cloudy urine.
advice: Drink plenty of water
Do not hold your urine for long
Avoid irritants like coffee and alcohol
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor; UTIs usually need antibiotics. Seek care quickly if you have fever or back pain.
red_flags: Pain in the back or side

diseases.name: Varicose Veins
diseases.description: Enlarged, twisted veins, usually in the legs, which can cause aching, heaviness and swelling.
advice: Avoid standing or sitting for long periods
Elevate your legs when resting
Walk regularly and keep a healthy weight
diseases.see_doctor: See a doctor if the veins are painful, the skin changes color or you develop sores near the ankle.
red_flags: A swollen, painful, warm leg (possible blood clot)
